jobs.list.title: List jobs (careers)
jobs.list.description: List published career-site job postings via Careers Site API GET /offers on {company}.recruitee.com. Returns NormalizedJob rows. Distinct from offers.list (ATS admin offers).

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via ATS API GET /c/{company}/candidates. Optional limit, offset, offerId, and query filters.

pipeline_stages.list.title: List pipeline stages
pipeline_stages.list.description: List pipeline stages from an offer (offerId), a pipeline template (pipelineTemplateId), or all company pipeline templates via the ATS API.

offers.list.title: List offers (ATS)
offers.list.description: List company offers (jobs/talent pools) via authenticated ATS API GET /c/{company}/offers. Richer admin listing than careers jobs.list.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Recruitee connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated ATS API GET /c/{company}/candidates/{id}. Includes placements and profile fields.

candidates.search.title: Search candidates
candidates.search.description: Search candidates via authenticated ATS API GET /c/{company}/search/new/candidates. Optional query (all-field filter), filtersJson, limit, page, and sortBy.

interview_events.list.title: List interview events
interview_events.list.description: List scheduled interview events via authenticated ATS API GET /c/{company}/interview/events. Optional candidateId, date range, scope, status, adminIds, limit, and page filters.
